title: Beyond Handcrafted Security: Towards Self-Evolving Defense for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.12977v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The expanding operational capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents introduce sophisticated security threats. Runtime defenses have emerged as an effective approach to mitigating these risks by integrating security mechanisms into the agent execution loop. However, existing runtime defenses rely heavily on manually designed interventions and lack a principled framework for their construction and maintenance. In this work, we first develop a harness-level formulation of runtime defense that systematically characterizes how harness mechanisms enable defense construction and provides a unified view of existing runtime defense interventions from a harness perspective. translated_title: 超越手工安全：迈向LLM代理的自进化防御
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理不断扩展的操作能力引入了复杂的安全威胁。运行时防御通过将安全机制集成到代理执行循环中，已成为缓解这些风险的有效方法。然而，现有的运行时防御严重依赖手动设计的干预措施，缺乏构建和维护这些措施的原则性框架。在这项工作中，我们首先开发了一种基于框架（harness-level）的运行时防御形式化描述，系统性地表征了框架机制如何支持防御构建，并从框架视角提供了现有运行时防御干预措施的统一视图。基于这一形式化描述，我们提出了HARD（基于框架的自主运行时防御进化），一个自进化的运行时防御框架，能够自动识别合适的干预策略，并根据观察结果迭代改进防御工件。
tldr: 本文提出了一种自进化运行时防御框架HARD，通过形式化框架机制并自动迭代优化防御策略，克服了现有LLM代理防御依赖人工设计的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HARD, a self-evolving runtime defense framework that formalizes harness mechanisms and automatically iteratively optimizes defense strategies, overcoming the limitations of manual design in existing LLM agent defenses.
